name: 74110 · Tulsa, OK
findings: ZIP 74110 (Tulsa) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 8 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74110 (Tulsa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 74110 (Tulsa) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
